start: Import from Hevy screen, member has a shared Hevy folder link copied

steps.action: Under 'Have a Hevy routine link?' tap 'Paste a Hevy link'
user_sees: Screen 'Import routines' with a paste box and 'Read link' (greyed while empty)
must_not: The link read before 'Read link' is tapped

steps.action: Paste the link and tap 'Read link'
user_sees: 'Reading your Hevy link…' and 'This takes a few seconds.' with a Cancel button
must_not: A visible Hevy web page
Hevy's app or another site opened

steps.action: Wait
user_sees: 'We found 4 routines in “PPL”' and 'Copied exactly as saved in Hevy: warm-ups, sets, reps and rest.'
must_not: Routines missing without a word (a part read says so and offers 'Try again' or 'Use these N')

steps.action: Tick routines, go Next through the new-names step and pick a folder
user_sees: 'We add them to your exercises with the same name, so your Hevy history and these routines stay together.'
'Your plan only changes if you pick it.'
'Follow these as your plan?'
must_not: The followed plan replaced without the member picking it

start: Settings import card, member has a Strong export .csv

steps.action: Tap Strong, then 'Choose Strong file' and pick the file
user_sees: Screen 'Import from Strong'; a preview and a units question 'Kilograms and km' / 'Pounds and miles' with an example set
must_not: Weights guessed as kg without asking

steps.action: Look at the import button before answering
user_sees: The button reads 'Choose kg or lb first'
must_not: An import that can start before kg or lb is chosen

steps.action: Pick 'Pounds and miles' and import
user_sees: The result screen; a 100 lb set shows as 45.4 kg
must_not: Pounds saved as kilograms

start: Import from Hevy screen

steps.action: Pick a .csv that is not a Hevy or Strong export
user_sees: 'This file isn’t a Hevy or Strong export. In Hevy: Settings → Export & Backup Data. In Strong: Settings → Export Strong Data.'
must_not: A preview of a random file
A crash

steps.action: Pick an export with no workouts
user_sees: 'No workouts were found in that file.'
must_not: An import button for zero workouts

steps.action: On 'Import routines' paste 'hevy.com/user/abc' and tap 'Read link'
user_sees: 'That isn’t a Hevy share link. It looks like hevy.com/folder/… or hevy.com/routine/…'
must_not: The page opened anyway

steps.action: Paste a deleted routine link
user_sees: A plain message that the link was not found, back on the paste box
must_not: An endless 'Reading your Hevy link…' (the reader gives up after 35 s)

start: Member already imported the same Hevy file once, and also has own MettleUp workouts

steps.action: Pick the same file again
user_sees: Row 'Already in MettleUp' with the count, and a note that the file is already here
must_not: The same workouts offered as new

steps.action: Keep Merge and import
user_sees: 'Every workout in this file was already in MettleUp.' with 'Already imported (skipped)'
must_not: Duplicate workouts in history

steps.action: Pick Replace and import
user_sees: Ask 'Delete 12 workouts first?' with a red 'Replace' button
must_not: Workouts deleted without asking

steps.action: Confirm, then tap 'Undo import' on the result
user_sees: 'Undoing…' then the history exactly as before
must_not: Imported workouts left behind

start: Settings import card

steps.action: Read the line under the two apps
user_sees: 'Your file is read on your phone. Nothing is uploaded.'
must_not: The file sent to a MettleUp server

steps.action: Paste a Hevy link and read it
user_sees: Only the Hevy page is opened, hidden, in a private browser that keeps no cache
must_not: Hevy sign-in asked

steps.action: Finish an import with Health Connect linked
user_sees: Imported workouts sent to Health Connect only as the member's Health setting allows
must_not: Imported workouts sent to Health Connect when the member chose not to send past workouts
